en.title: Some Time for Time
en.text:
The sour belch rising up
soaks
the unspoken words.
An awkward breath
comes by an easier path;
though within a mass of air,
a little lies outside.
I count it among the countable,
even knowing it is countless.
I shall sow some time into it.
I have arranged all the stale words to say;
the dense sounds I hear—
before whom shall I pour them out?
By speaking, cheapening them,
shall I punish myself?
Even wearing the garment of a question,
the body's skin emerges outside.
What cannot be seen even when not hidden
remains unhidden, unsaid.
Even on seeing the unseen,
that other day feels more alive.
It takes some time to look at time,
whether gone or yet to come.
Today is a corpse inside a white sheet;
it seems fresh only,
only because it is today,
only because it is now.

hi.title: समय के लिए कुछ समय
hi.text:
उठती हुई खट्टी डकार
भिगो देती है
अनकही बातों को।
अटपटी साँस
सुगम राह से आती है;
ढेर सारी हवा के भीतर होते हुए भी
कुछ बाहर रह जाता है।
गिनती में गिन लेती हूँ,
अनगिनत जानते हुए भी।
उसमें कुछ समय बो दूँगी।
कहने को सारी बासी बातें सँजो रखी हैं;
सुने जा रहे गाढ़े शब्दों को
किसके आगे उँडेल दूँ?
कहकर सस्ता बनाकर
क्या अपने को दंड दूँ?
प्रश्न की पोशाक पहनने पर भी
देह की चमड़ी बाहर निकल आती है।
जो न छिपाने पर भी नहीं दिखता,
अनछिपा, अनकहा हो जाता है।
अनदेखे को देख लेने पर भी
कल कुछ अधिक जीवंत लगता है।
समय देखने को कुछ समय लगता है,
बीत चुका हो या आने वाला।
आज सफ़ेद चादर के भीतर का शव है;
ताज़ा लगता है केवल,
केवल आज होने से,
केवल अभी होने से।

en.title: The Girl Who Writes Poems
en.text:
They say she
calls the stars to the terrace at midnight
and talks with an open heart.
She makes a companion of darkness,
turns the sky into a twelve-cubit sari
and wears it every day.
She makes thick sorrow into kohl and lines her eyes.
Sometimes she laughs greatly for no reason,
then sometimes cries all night without a cause.
The girl who writes poems looks just like this.

In the spices cooking down
she draws her own reflection;
in the blast of smoke again
she writes the future.
Laying flowers in the prayer room,
she strings words together.
In the skylight's light
she seeks her own soul.
The girl who writes poems, within herself,
is lost again and again.

She is no one in disguise, no performer;
seeing everything, she pretends not to see.
Not once or twice, a poet dies ceaselessly,
brings many questions about life's entanglements.
The girl who writes poems can understand it all.

More than with a companion, she stays with words,
sometimes thinking them lover, sometimes Lord.
She makes dreams her breath and stays alive,
laughs with dreams, then sulks with dreams.
The girl who writes poems looks just like this.

Sometimes black clouds call her by name,
sometimes darkness too draws her likeness.
In markets and at river landings she is praised;
beneath her own roof she is rebuked.
Sometimes over poetry, then sometimes
new labels are given to her character.
The girl who writes poems suffers just this way.

She speaks little, thinks much,
sometimes grows very happy even with false praise.
She makes feeling a necklace and wears it daily;
that is what she thinks of as wealth.
The girl who writes poems is just like this.

Grieved by others' sorrow, she does not think of herself;
she cannot bear injustice at all.
More than with herself, she lives with thoughts;
what she calls her life is thought alone.
They say the girl who writes poems is wholly simple-hearted.

Within strict discipline she feels suffocated,
condemns a life bound by fixed rules.
Sometimes she sees God as human, and humans as God.
She rules the territory of her own mind.
The girl who writes poems lives just like herself;
she experiences poetry, thinks poetry.
The girl who writes poems lives just like herself.

hi.title: कविता लिखने वाली लड़की
hi.text:
कहते हैं वह
तारों को आधी रात छत पर बुलाकर
मन खोलकर बातें करती है।
अँधेरे से संगत जोड़ती है,
आकाश को बारह हाथ की साड़ी
बनाकर रोज़ पहनती है।
गाढ़ी वेदना को काजल बनाकर आँखों में लगाती है।
बिना कारण कभी बहुत हँसती है,
फिर कभी बिना कारण सारी रात रोती है।
कविता लिखने वाली लड़की ठीक ऐसी ही दिखती है।

भुनते हुए मसालों में
अपना प्रतिबिंब बनाती है;
धुएँ की धाँस में फिर
भविष्य लिखती है।
पूजाघर में फूल रखकर
शब्दों को गूँथती है।
रोशनदान के उजाले में
अपनी आत्मा खोजती है।
कविता लिखने वाली लड़की अपने ही भीतर
बार-बार खो जाती है।

वह छद्मवेशी नहीं, कलाकार नहीं;
सब देखकर न देखने का झूठा अभिनय करती है।
एक या दो बार नहीं, कवि निरंतर मरता है,
जीवन की उलझनों पर बहुत प्रश्न लाती है।
कविता लिखने वाली लड़की सब समझ जाती है।

साथी से अधिक वह शब्दों के पास रहती है,
कभी उन्हें प्रेमी, कभी प्रभु समझती है।
सपनों को साँस बनाकर जीवित रहती है,
सपनों के साथ हँसती, फिर सपनों से रूठती है।
कविता लिखने वाली लड़की ऐसी ही दिखती है।

काले बादल कभी उसका नाम लेकर बुलाते हैं,
अँधेरा भी कभी-कभी उसका चित्र बनाता है।
हाट-घाट पर उसकी वाहवाही होती है;
अपनी छत के नीचे उसका तिरस्कार होता है।
कभी कविता को लेकर, फिर कभी
चरित्र को नए नाम दिए जाते हैं।
कविता लिखने वाली लड़की ऐसा ही सहती है।

वह कम बोलती है, अधिक सोचती है,
झूठी प्रशंसा से भी कभी बहुत खुश होती है।
भावों का हार बनाकर रोज़ पहनती है;
उसी को वह अपनी संपत्ति समझती है।
कविता लिखने वाली लड़की ऐसी ही होती है।

पराए दुख से दुखी, अपनी बात नहीं सोचती;
अन्याय देखकर बिल्कुल सह नहीं पाती।
अपने से अधिक वह विचारों के साथ रहती है;
उसका जीवन कहो तो विचार ही होते हैं।
कहते हैं कविता लिखने वाली लड़की पूरी भोली होती है।

अनुशासन के भीतर उसका दम घुटता है,
बँधी-बँधाई ज़िंदगी की बहुत निंदा करती है।
कभी ईश्वर को मनुष्य, कभी मनुष्य को ईश्वर समझती है।
अपने मन के इलाक़े पर अपना राज रखती है।
कविता लिखने वाली लड़की बिल्कुल अपने जैसी जीती है;
कविता को भोगती है, कविता को सोचती है।
कविता लिखने वाली लड़की बिल्कुल अपने जैसी जीती है।

en.title: Woman
en.text:
To water love every moment
is a woman's distinction.
Each unresolved
thread of problems,
to untangle it slowly, slowly,
is her nature.
She sets her colourful, rosy desires
aside, and on thorny paths
walks gladly,
because this gives her family
a good status.
She crosses contradictions
and an atmosphere fit for companionship
she nurtures,
although she knows that in the end
everyone must go far away.
She is detached, in the guise of worldly illusion,
a renunciant against the backdrop of action,
a blazing utterance
of the suppleness of tender words.
In a body of flesh
an iron feeling lies hidden.
She is strī, on whose long ī vowel-mark
alone lie many burdens, many betrayals.
Yet she draws out this vowel-mark
so well,
with grace,
with tenderness,
and with a philosopher's understanding.

or.title: ନାରୀ
or.text:
ପ୍ରେମକୁ ପ୍ରତି ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତରେ ସିଞ୍ଚିବା
ନାରୀର ବିଶେଷତ୍ୱ।
ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଅସମାହିତ
ସମସ୍ୟାର ସୂତାକୁ
ଧୀରେ ଧୀରେ ସଜାଡ଼ିବା
ତା'ର ସ୍ୱଭାବ।
ସେ ରଙ୍ଗଭରା ଗୋଲାପୀ ଆକାଂକ୍ଷାକୁ
ପାଖେଇଦେଇ କଣ୍ଟାଭରା ବାଟରେ
ଖୁସିରେ ଚାଲିଯାଏ,
କାରଣ ଏଥିରେ ତା' ପରିବାରକୁ
ଏକ ଭଲ ସାମାଜିକ ସ୍ଥିତି ମିଳେ।
ସେ ଅସଂଗତିକୁ ପାର କରେ
ଆଉ ସଙ୍ଗତି କରିବା ଯୋଗ୍ୟ ପରିବେଶ
ପୋଷଣ କରେ,
ଯଦିଓ ଜାଣେ ଶେଷରେ
ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କୁ ଦୂରେ ଯିବାକୁ ହେବ।
ସେ ମାୟାର ବେଶରେ ବୈରାଗୀ,
କର୍ମର ପୃଷ୍ଠଭୂମିରେ ସନ୍ନ୍ୟାସୀ,
ଏକ ଜ୍ୱଳନ୍ତ ଉଦ୍‌ଗାର
କୋମଳ ଶବ୍ଦର ନମନୀୟତାର।
ମାଂସଳ ଦେହରେ
ଲୁଚିଛି ଏକ ଲୌହ ଆବେଗ।
ସେ ସ୍ତ୍ରୀ, ଯାହାର ଦୀର୍ଘ ଈ-କାର ମାତ୍ରା ଉପରେ
ହିଁ ଅନେକ ଭାର, ଅନେକ ବିଶ୍ୱାସଘାତ।
ତଥାପି ସେ ଏହି ମାତ୍ରାକୁ
ସୁନ୍ଦର ଭାବେ ଟାଣିନିଏ,
ସୁଶୃଙ୍ଖଳ ଭାବେ,
କୋମଳତାରେ,
ଆଉ ଦାର୍ଶନିକତାରେ।

en.title: Separation
en.text:
Night kept moving; sleep never came;
I could not remain true to love even in a dream.
The longing to meet you woke in my heart,
yet I still could not come to meet you.

I had seen you through the window that evening,
but when you turned, these eyes lowered.
My heart would beat because of you, yet
at the sight of you its beat seemed to stop.
When our eyes could not even meet, what use?
I could not show you love in my eyes.

I kept living you, kept dying for you,
slowly, slowly, descending into you.
Then in my heart's dark settlement,
a few lamps bearing your name kept burning.
If word gets out, beloved, there will be upheaval;
yet I could not keep the words pressed between my lips.

In the mahua's shade, beneath moonlight,
we once promised to meet.
In a moment my heart was once touched
by dew and light together.
I spread my eyelashes on your path to wait,
but could not clear the thorns from my own roads.

If I am form, you are love's gaze;
without you, even existing, I am nothing.
You are my evening; I am a woman ascetic, beloved;
you are my everything, I am nothing of yours.
These distances of years and years stand still;
though I wished, I could not erase them.
The longing to meet you woke in my heart,
yet I still could not come to meet you.

or.title: ବିରହ
or.text:
ରାତି ଚାଲିଲା, ନିଦ ଆସିଲା ନାହିଁ,
ସ୍ୱପ୍ନରେ ବି ପ୍ରେମ ନିଭାଇ ପାରିଲି ନାହିଁ।
ତୁମକୁ ଭେଟିବାର ତୃଷ୍ଣା ହୃଦୟରେ ଜାଗିଲା,
ତଥାପି ତୁମକୁ ଭେଟିବାକୁ ଆସି ପାରିଲି ନାହିଁ।

ସଞ୍ଜରେ ଝରକାରୁ ତୁମକୁ ଦେଖିଥିଲି,
ତୁମେ ବୁଲି ଚାହିଁଲେ ଏ ଆଖି ନଇଁଗଲା।
ତୁମ ପାଇଁ ମୋ ହୃଦୟ ଧଡ଼କୁଥିଲା, ମାତ୍ର
ତୁମକୁ ଦେଖି ଏ ସ୍ପନ୍ଦନ ଅଟକିଗଲା ପରି।
ଆଖି ଯେବେ ମିଶିପାରିଲା ନାହିଁ, ଲାଭ କ'ଣ?
ଆଖିରେ ତୁମକୁ ପ୍ରେମ ଦେଖାଇ ପାରିଲି ନାହିଁ।

ତୁମକୁ ବଞ୍ଚୁଥିଲି, ତୁମ ପାଇଁ ମରୁଥିଲି,
ଧୀରେ ଧୀରେ ତୁମ ଭିତରକୁ ଓହ୍ଲାଉଥିଲି।
ମୋ ହୃଦୟର ଅନ୍ଧାର ବସତିରେ ପୁଣି
ତୁମ ନାମର କିଛି ଦୀପ ଜଳୁଥିଲା।
କଥା ବାହାରିଲେ ପ୍ରଳୟ ହେବ, ପ୍ରିୟ,
ତଥାପି ଓଠରେ କଥା ଚାପି ରଖି ପାରିଲି ନାହିଁ।

ମହୁଲ ଛାଇରେ, ଜହ୍ନ ଆଲୁଅ ତଳେ,
ତୁମ ସହ ଭେଟିବାର ପ୍ରତିଶ୍ରୁତି ହୋଇଥିଲା ଦିନେ।
ଗୋଟିଏ ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତରେ ମୋ ମନକୁ କାକର ଆଉ
ଆଲୋକ ମିଶି ଛୁଇଁଥିଲେ ଦିନେ।
ତୁମ ବାଟରେ ପଲକ ବିଛାଇ ଅପେକ୍ଷା କଲି,
ନିଜ ବାଟରୁ କଣ୍ଟା ହଟାଇ ପାରିଲି ନାହିଁ।

ମୁଁ ରୂପ ହେଲେ ତୁମେ ପ୍ରେମର ଦୃଷ୍ଟି,
ତୁମ ବିନା ମୁଁ ଥାଇ ବି କିଛି ନୁହେଁ।
ତୁମେ ମୋ ସଞ୍ଜ, ମୁଁ ଯୋଗିନୀ ପ୍ରିୟ,
ତୁମେ ମୋର ସବୁ, ମୁଁ ତୁମର କିଛି ନୁହେଁ।
ବର୍ଷ ବର୍ଷର ଏ ଦୂରତା ଅଚଳ,
ଚାହିଁଲେ ବି ଏ ଦୂରତା ଲିଭାଇ ପାରିଲି ନାହିଁ।
ତୁମକୁ ଭେଟିବାର ତୃଷ୍ଣା ହୃଦୟରେ ଜାଗିଲା,
ତଥାପି ତୁମକୁ ଭେଟିବାକୁ ଆସି ପାରିଲି ନାହିଁ।

en.title: She Who Takes on My Colour
en.text:
Once this heart was mine alone;
I kept listening only to my heart.
Since you arrived, dear friend,
I have kept weaving golden dreams.

I am yours now, you are mine;
what else is there for us to do?
Finding you does not fill my heart;
I kept choosing you from yourself.

Each moment you grow within my eyes;
will someone cast an evil eye?
I offered this kohl over you to ward it off,
kept contemplating you within my eyes.

When I looked with eyelids closed,
your image alone was exquisite.
Just keep speaking like this;
I kept listening only to you.

Until I had found you,
the courtyard of my heart was empty.
Now my heart is like a garden;
like flowers I kept blooming.

Your colour took hold of me so
that body and mind grew dark-hued.
A fair complexion no longer pleased me;
I kept being dyed in Shyam's dark hue.

or.title: ମୋ ରଙ୍ଗରେ ରଙ୍ଗେଇ ହେଉଥିବା ସେ
or.text:
ଆଗରୁ ଏ ହୃଦୟ ମୋର ହିଁ ଥିଲା,
ମୁଁ ଖାଲି ମନର କଥା ଶୁଣୁଥିଲି।
ଯେବେଠାରୁ ତୁମେ ଆସିଛ ସଖା,
ସୁନେଲି ସ୍ୱପ୍ନ ବୁଣି ଚାଲିଛି।

ମୁଁ ଏବେ ତୁମର, ତୁମେ ମୋର,
ଆଉ ଆମର କ'ଣ କରିବାର ଅଛି?
ତୁମକୁ ପାଇ ମନ ଭରେନାହିଁ,
ତୁମ ଭିତରୁ ତୁମକୁ ବାଛି ଚାଲିଛି।

ଆଖିରେ ପ୍ରତି କ୍ଷଣ ତୁମେ ବଢ଼ୁଛ,
କାହାର ନଜର ଲାଗିଯିବ କି?
ଏ ଅଞ୍ଜନ ତୁମ ଉପରେ ବାରିଦେଲି,
ତୁମକୁ ନୟନରେ ଧ୍ୟାଇ ଚାଲିଛି।

ପଲକ ବନ୍ଦ କରି ଯେବେ ଦେଖିଲି,
ତୁମ ଛବି ହିଁ ଅନନ୍ୟ ଥିଲା।
ତୁମେ ଖାଲି ଏମିତି କହି ଚାଲ,
ମୁଁ ଖାଲି ତୁମକୁ ଶୁଣି ଚାଲିଛି।

ଯେତେଦିନ ତୁମେ ମୋତେ ମିଳିନଥିଲ,
ହୃଦୟର ଅଗଣା ଶୂନ୍ୟ ଥିଲା।
ଏବେ ମୋ ମନ ଉପବନ ପରି,
ଫୁଲ ପରି ମୁଁ ଫୁଟି ଚାଲିଛି।

ମୋ ଉପରେ ତୁମ ରଙ୍ଗ ଏମିତି ଚଢ଼ିଲା,
ଶ୍ୟାମଳ ହେଲା ତନୁ ମନ।
ଗୌର ବର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଆଉ ଭଲ ଲାଗେନା,
ଶ୍ୟାମ ରଙ୍ଗରେ ରଙ୍ଗେଇ ଚାଲିଛି।
